name: Cerda (Italy)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cerda (trees on blue above green) within branches, with the inscriptions COMUNE DI CERDA and CITTÀ METROPOLITANA DI PALERMO in white beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Cerda, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 18 April 2011.

features.role: Cerda arms — trees on blue above green, crowned, within branches
inscriptions COMUNE DI CERDA and CITTÀ METROPOLITANA DI PALERMO beneath the arms
